name: Synfig
category: A7. Native applications and procedural tools
role: synfig CLI renders .sif and .sifz 2D vector animation projects to frames or video
summary: Open-source 2D vector and bitmap animation studio. The synfig CLI renders .sif, .sifz and .sfg project files to PNG sequences, GIF or video at chosen size and frame range, with tweened vertices, bones and layers. Strength is cut-out and vector tweening authored visually and rendered headlessly. macOS packaging is the weak spot; Homebrew disabled its cask.
use_when: An existing .sif project from an animator must render headlessly
Vector tweening and bone rigs authored visually, over Blender grease pencil
Frame-range renders of a 2D project to PNG with alpha
avoid_when: Reliable macOS arm64 install today: Blender or Inkscape
notes: 2026-10-26: Homebrew cask synfigstudio (1.4.5) was disabled 2026-09-01 for failing Gatekeeper, so install.macos was removed. Release 1.5.5 ships SynfigStudio-1.5.5-20260315.dmg; its CPU architecture is not stated in the asset name, so arm64 support is unverified. App-bundle CLI path is assumed.

assessment.rationale: 1.5.5 released 2026-03-16 with a macOS dmg and the repo was pushed 2026-10-25. The Homebrew cask is disabled for Gatekeeper and dmg architecture is unstated, so macOS arm64 is unverified; keep tier but flag install.
